clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Sven Yorgen tests your strength before he lets you face Morbent Fel. The hermit seeks revenge for his family and needs proof you can overcome the undead at Raven Hill Cemetery.

At a secluded camp north of the howling woods, Sven Yorgen grieves for his family and burns with fury over their slaughter. He has learned that the Dark Riders who destroyed his homestead were allied with the necromancer Morbent Fel. Sven wants revenge, but he will not send an untried ally straight into Fel's grasp. First, he asks you to prove your combat skill against the skeletal forces at Raven Hill Cemetery.

Raven Hill Cemetery lies south of Forlorn Rowe, and its grounds and mausoleum crawl with corpses bound by Fel's magic. Skeletal Raiders patrol among the tombstones with swords, while Skeletal Warders and Healers tend the chambers below. To earn Sven's trust, you must push deep into the necropolis and clear this vanguard. Mor'Ladim, a vengeful phantom, prowls the cemetery paths.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders. I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.
You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Battle hard, friend. And do not despair, for despair is evil's greatest weapon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your skill in combat, Friend, can not be doubted. Your resolve may yet see us through to the end of Morbent Fel!
